verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a static Core API reference with per-endpoint pages (e.g., check-availability, create-domain, create-record) and a separate sandbox testing environment. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable "try it" examples. A plain reference and a sandbox for integration tests are adjacent capabilities, not an interactive API explorer, and no OpenAPI spec was found either (all OpenAPI paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
